title: Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt H2O 10ml E-Liquid By Ultimate Juice
description: Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt's H2O e-liquid is a unique and refreshing take on vaping, offering the crisp, clean taste of fizzy spring water complemented by a subtle citrus undertone. This innovative flavour provides a hydrating vape experience, reminiscent of sipping a cool glass of sparkling water with a twist of lemon or lime, making it a perfect choice for vapers seeking refreshment and a light, clean taste. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between rich flavour and ample cloud production, while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it caters to both moderate and high nicotine preferences. Nicotine salts’ unique alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine without the harshness, delivering a smoother throat hit compared to high-strength freebase liquids. They are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings, making Nic salt e-liquids a superior choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate satisfaction. Inspired by the intense and super-satisfying flavours of the brand’s bestselling Ultimate Bar disposable vape devices, the Ultimate 5000 Bar Salt range includes a collection of 20 irresistible flavours that span classic favourites as well as exciting new blends, ensuring a premium vaping experience for every palate.
